title: Workout Count At Least
prompt: A workout dashboard receives workout reps. Write a function that returns how many values are greater than or equal to the minimum rep count.

explanation.beginner:
Example: workoutCountAtLeast([5,10,12,0], 8) produces 2. The result must follow this precise rule: A workout dashboard receives workout reps. Write a function that returns how many values are greater than or equal to the minimum rep count. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns zero when none qualify”: input [[-1,0],8] produces 0. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
